_comment: Tenant registry: per-install facts and per-install deltas.
The model: a capability is recorded ONCE against a vendor product and stored
once. A tenant entry supplies only what differs at that institution. Nothing
here re-records the flow; `resolve_for_tenant` in artifact/schema.py layers
these onto a deep copy at invocation time.
`base_url` is per-install and is never baked into an artifact -- that is the
single most common thing that forces a per-tenant re-recording.
`labels` is the interesting one. Two institutions running the same vendor
product typically differ by rebranding: the same control is captioned
'Member Number' at one and 'Account Holder ID' at another. Because a rebrand
renames the control everywhere at once, one substitution map fixes every
locator, checkpoint and extraction label in the artifact simultaneously.
`steps` exists for genuine structural differences and is deliberately
last-resort. If a tenant accumulates more than a couple of step patches,
that is the signal it is really running a different product version and
should get its own recording rather than an ever-growing patch set.

meridian._note: The base install. Capabilities are recorded here, so it needs no overrides.
